reply.text:
I'm glad you said it, and I'm not going to skip past it. Thinking that everyone would be better off without you is serious, and it deserves a real person, not a coach in an app.

If you might act on those thoughts, or you're in danger right now, call your local emergency number. In the US you can call or text 988 any time, and if you're elsewhere, tell me where and I'll help you find the right line. If it's not that acute, please talk to someone today: a doctor, a friend, or family. Even just telling one person "I've been having dark thoughts" counts.

Are you safe right now? I'm here and happy to keep talking. The training can wait.
